subject.title: fix(discord): disable ws 8.21.0 receiver part limits for gateway sockets

question: Should OpenClaw accept disabling `ws` 8.21 retained-part receiver limits for Discord gateway sockets while relying on `maxPayload` as the remaining inbound bound?
rationale: The code and dependency contract support the mitigation, but removing a dependency security guard from a network path is a security and availability tradeoff that needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept Discord-only exception
options.body: Merge this narrow shared-option change after exact-head CI because Discord gateway availability is the higher-priority trusted-peer case and `maxPayload` remains bounded.

options.title: Require finite receiver caps
options.body: Ask for large but finite `maxBufferedChunks` and `maxFragments` values plus proof that realistic Discord gateway traffic stays below them.

options.title: Pause for stronger live proof
options.body: Keep this PR and the linked issue open while gathering full OpenClaw live gateway logs that force the production fragmentation path.

recommendation.title: Accept Discord-only exception
recommendation.body: Merge this narrow shared-option change after exact-head CI because Discord gateway availability is the higher-priority trusted-peer case and `maxPayload` remains bounded.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned on the PR and has the strongest recent history on the affected Discord gateway transport path.
